import numpy as np

def dynamics(t, x, u):
    position_1, velocity_1, position_2, velocity_2 = x
    force_1, force_2 = u
    mass_1, mass_2 = 1.0, 1.5
    ground_spring_1, ground_spring_2, coupling_spring = 1.0, 1.2, 2.0
    ground_damping_1, ground_damping_2, coupling_damping = 0.25, 0.30, 0.20
    coupling_force_on_1 = -coupling_spring * (position_1 - position_2) - coupling_damping * (velocity_1 - velocity_2)
    acceleration_1 = (force_1 - ground_spring_1 * position_1 - ground_damping_1 * velocity_1 + coupling_force_on_1) / mass_1
    acceleration_2 = (force_2 - ground_spring_2 * position_2 - ground_damping_2 * velocity_2 - coupling_force_on_1) / mass_2
    return np.array([velocity_1, acceleration_1, velocity_2, acceleration_2], dtype=float)
